title: Choose borrowed, mutable or consuming iteration
summary: Inspect a collection, update its elements in place and finally move each owned string into a new collection.

binding.clue: Modifier allowing mutable iteration over names

sizesType.clue: Owned collection type holding the byte lengths

borrowed.clue: Collection method yielding shared references and retaining ownership of names

transform.clue: Iterator adapter producing one length per borrowed name

gather.clue: Consumer gathering the lengths into the annotated vector

mutable.clue: Collection method yielding exclusive references to each owned name

append.clue: String method appending the single ! character during mutation

ownedType.clue: Destination vector type owning the moved strings

consuming.clue: Collection method transferring each owned element out of names

equal.clue: Macro checking both moved and decorated strings
